reuse.why: The change reuses tag parsing, budget writes, batching and undo wrappers, but introduces parallel group-note storage instead of using the existing notes subsystem.

duplication.why: Five actions repeat the category-selection query and eligibility guards, while copyPreviousMonth expresses the same exclusions separately in JavaScript.

placement.why: Budget operations and method registration follow existing layering, but adding category_groups.notes duplicates responsibility already assigned to the notes table and notes API.

scope.why: The edits address the requested budget actions, apart from unrelated whitespace changes in init.sql.

maintainability.why: Maintainers must coordinate eligibility changes across six actions and reconcile two representations of group notes.

bypasses_abstraction.where: The new category_groups.notes column and g.notes queries bypass the existing notes subsystem used by CategoryGroupMenuModal through useNotes(group.id) and notes-get.

disguised_duplication.where: copyPreviousMonth expresses hidden-category and saved-template exclusions as JavaScript predicates, duplicating the SQL predicates repeated in setZero, setLastMonthSpending and the three average actions.

abstraction_drift.where: The shared isFixedGroup helper remains narrow and all six actions call it; eligibility logic is duplicated outside it rather than accumulated as helper parameters or special cases.
